hero.texto: We invite you to approach the listening points and play the corresponding audio. Please don't use your device's speaker — listen with headphones, or as if you were on a phone call.

bienvenida.titulo: Welcome to the House Over the Stream
bienvenida.texto: Explore the space and discover its history through the audio guides, listening to each point with your headphones.
